headline: A 2012 executive order took more steps under an existing national emergency involving Somalia.
what_it_does: This order builds on a national emergency involving Somalia that the President had already declared. Its title says it takes 'additional steps' to address that emergency. Orders like this often expand economic sanctions, such as freezing property or barring dealings with certain people, but no summary was provided to confirm the details.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups tied to the situation in Somalia
who_it_affects.how: They may face new limits under the order, but the exact rules are not described in the material provided.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and individuals dealing with Somalia
who_it_affects.how: They may need to follow any new restrictions the order adds, though the specifics are not given here.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 20, 2012; the material provided gives no separate effective date.
